# Frame (fixture: blatant method defence - the lexical pass must catch these)

## Gap statement

Prior sorters report high accuracy on factory hardware (established).
No work quantifies the desktop-hardware case (not established).
Repair shops with the burden cannot afford the studied platforms (why it matters).

## Literature themes

Weight-based sorting treats each part as a point mass. We chose a load cell
because it resolves differences a camera cannot see. This approach allows the
system to avoid the visual-similarity failure mode entirely.
